title: Insert Data in Disconnected Scenario
description: Learn to insert disconnected entities, relational data, and multiple records.

data.text: In the **disconnected scenario**, the DbContext is not aware of entities because they were created outside the scope of the current DbContext instance. You need to attach disconnected entities with appropriate EntityState.

rows: Sets Unchanged for entities with keys, Added for empty keys
